categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as a global leading AI terminal hardware core supplier, focusing on intelligent manufacturing services and solutions. Its business segments include AI smartphones and foldable phones, AI PCs and tablets, imaging display, materials, battery power, thermal management (cooling), AI glasses and XR wearable devices, boutique assembly, sensors and related modules, and robotics. It also has significant involvement in automotive and low-altitude economy sectors, as well as clean energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as precision mold processing, stamping, CNC machining, injection molding, and automated production lines including AGV and robotic automation. It has developed intelligent AOI inspection systems, high-speed precision stamping, continuous stamping production lines, and unmanned green anodizing production lines. The company integrates lean manufacturing with digitalization, automation, and green manufacturing principles, and invests heavily in R&D for materials like carbon fiber, thermal management solutions like vapor chambers, and robotics components including reducers and controllers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global AI terminal product brands and their upstream suppliers, with major clients such as AMD, Brembo, Huawei, Xiaomi, Lenovo, BOE, and Honor. The company serves industries including consumer electronics (smartphones, PCs, wearables), automotive (especially new energy vehicles), robotics, and clean energy sectors. It also targets emerging markets like AI glasses, foldable screens, servers, and low-altitude economy applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in China, including Guangdong, Jiangmen, Dongguan, Shenzhen, and other regions. It has overseas bases that have achieved localized operations, with significant sales in North America, Europe, and emerging markets such as Vietnam, India, Brazil, Singapore, Turkey, and Finland. The overseas business is expanding rapidly, aiming for a dual circulation model between domestic and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the research, design, manufacturing, and assembly of core components and modules for AI terminal hardware. It extends upstream by developing key materials and components such as carbon fiber and battery structural parts, and downstream by providing ODM/OEM assembly services and integrated solutions. It also engages in system-level solutions for robotics and AI hardware platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation leadership, internationalization, and extending upstream capabilities. It focuses on developing new growth curves in robotics, server cooling, AI glasses, and low-altitude economy sectors. The R&D system is structured into three tiers: research institute, engineering college, and business unit R&D centers, with six sub-platforms including thermal module R&D and advanced materials. The company invests heavily in precision manufacturing technologies, automation, and green manufacturing, and collaborates with universities for talent and technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of AI terminal hardware components and modules, automotive parts, and clean energy products. The company also earns income from ODM/OEM assembly services and integrated manufacturing solutions. It engages in direct sales predominantly, with minimal distribution channel sales. Additional revenue streams include government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a global leader and benchmark setter in AI terminal hardware manufacturing, with a strong competitive edge in precision manufacturing, technology innovation, and comprehensive supply chain integration. It competes with other major suppliers in consumer electronics, automotive components, and robotics sectors. Its continuous innovation and strategic partnerships with top-tier clients reinforce its leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately 44.21 billion RMB, a year-over-year growth of 29.56%, with net profit attributable to shareholders of 1.753 billion RMB. The AI terminal segment accounts for over 92% of revenue and grew by 32.75%. The automotive and low-altitude economy segment grew by 52.90%. The company maintains strong cash flow, with operating cash inflow of 44.09 billion RMB and net cash increase of 3.14 billion RMB. It has a large workforce exceeding 85,000 employees and continues to expand its production capacity and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-end precision manufacturing capabilities, advanced technology integration, and comprehensive intelligent manufacturing solutions. Its unique value lies in its ability to provide one-stop AI terminal hardware manufacturing platforms, combining deep expertise in materials, thermal management, robotics, and assembly. It differentiates through lean, digital, automated, and green manufacturing processes, strong R&D capabilities, and close collaboration with leading global customers to deliver customized, high-quality, and innovative products that support emerging AI and new energy markets.
